# Repository documentation

The canonical project documentation is in the **[root README.md](../README.md)**.

That document covers:

- As-built architecture (FastAPI, SQLite, React, Ganache)
- Setup via `setup.ps1` / `setup.sh`
- Workflows (cases, evidence, verification, chain of custody, tamper detection)
- Security model (hashing + blockchain; **no encryption or authentication**)
- Future work roadmap

Subdirectory READMEs: `backend/`, `frontend/`, `blockchain/`, `docs/`.
